FULL REWRITE. You own homepage sections 7-13 plus page.tsx. Read the Webflow HTML + CSS, then WRITE the files. No planning.

Project: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/`

## STEP 1: Read Webflow source
Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` — find each section.
Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` — grep ALL classes.

## STEP 2: REWRITE these files

### benefits-grid.tsx — Section class: `works-sec`
- Padding: 20px 5% 60px, bg transparent
- Badge: "Our Benefits" — bg #21cfff12, border 1px solid #05bafe, border-radius 20px, padding 0 13px, font-size 12px, color white (wait — check the actual text color)
- h2 "Why Agencies Choose Boldteq Over Hiring": 40px/700/45px/mb 24px/center
- Subtitle: 16px/28px/center
- 6 cards in 3x2 grid (`.grid-three-column-2`), gap 24px
- Cards: bg #def4ff, border 1px solid #009ce0, border-radius 20px, padding 25px 17px 17px, text-align center
- Card title: `.subheading-large` 20px, font-weight 700
- Card description: `.paragraph-small-2` 16px/28px, color #2b2b2b, max-width 315px
- Each card has illustration image from /images/webflow/
- Hover: bg #c8ecfa, border #007db3

### how-it-works.tsx — Section class: `section-regular-3 blue-sec makeit-sec`
- Padding: 70px 5% 80px, bg #082753
- Badge: "How it works" — same badge style as benefits
- h2 "How Boldteq Works": 40px/700/45px/mb 24px/center/white
- Subtitle: 16px/28px/white/opacity .8/center
- 3 step cards in grid
- Cards: bg #1c3861, border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11), border-radius 20px
- Card title: `.subheading-large.white` 20px/700/white
- Card description: white, opacity .8
- Each card has screenshot image from /images/webflow/
- NO step numbers — just title + description + image

### pricing-section.tsx — Section class: `new-price-sec`
- Padding: 80px 5% 20px, bg white
- Badge: "Pricing"
- h2 "Pick a Flexible Subscription. Get Predictable Output.": 40px/700/45px/mb 24px
- Billing toggle: Monthly / Quarterly (Save 10%) / Annually (Save 20%)
  - Container: bg #f4f7fa, border-radius 10px, padding 5px 7px
  - Active tab: bg white, border-radius 8px, shadow
- 3 plan cards:
  - Starter: $999/mo — margin-top 42px, border-radius 15px, shadow 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.1)
  - Growth (Most Popular): $1,999/mo — border 3px solid #21cfff, border-top none, border-radius 20px, margin-top 0, "Most Popular" badge bg #18c958
  - Pro: $3,499/mo — same as Starter
- Plan name: gradient text (cyan to blue)
- Features list with check icons
- "Choose Plan" button: gradient, border-radius .75rem
- Comparison table: CSS grid rows with border-bottom 1px solid #21cfff36
- Custom plans section: bg #082753, "Need Something More Flexible?", "Build Your Custom Plan" button
- Prices change with billing period toggle
- Read `src/lib/constants/pricing.ts` for data

### comparison.tsx — Section class: `ways-sec`
- Padding: 0 5%
- Two-column grid
- Left "Traditional Way": bg #f4f7fa, padding 30px 40px, border-radius 20px
  - Red X bullet items (4 items)
  - 2 chat testimonial cards in 2-col grid, gap 22px, margin-top 30px
  - Chat cards: bg white, border-radius 13px, padding 14px 18px, shadow 0 14px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.12)
- Right "Boldteq Way": bg #21cfff12, padding 30px 40px, border-radius 20px
  - Green/blue check items (4 items)
  - 2 chat testimonial cards
  - Different chat style (gradient bg for Boldteq responses)
- h2s: 40px/700/45px/mb 20px

### faq-section.tsx — Section class: `faq-section home-faq`
- Padding: 60px 5% 70px
- Background image: Rectangle-30809.png
- Two-column layout: left (help links + heading), right (accordion)
- Left: badge "Have question in mind?", h2 "Frequently Asked Questions" 40px/700/45px
- Help center link + Send message link with icons
- Right: 8 FAQ items using shadcn Accordion
- FAQ item: border-radius, open state border highlight
- "See more questions" link at bottom
- Read `src/lib/constants/faq.ts` for exact Q&A data

### newsletter section (in page.tsx, uses shared component)
- Simple section with `src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx`
- Match the inline newsletter style from Webflow (not the footer version)

### beta-cta.tsx — The beta popup/CTA section
- bg #082753 deep, padding
- Inner card: border border-cyan/20, rounded-2xl, bg #082753
- "Exclusive Access" + "Private Beta Pricing"
- 4 benefit items with icons
- "Only 15 agencies will be accepted"
- "Join the Beta" CTA button

### page.tsx — Compose all 13 sections
Import and render all sections in order. NO wrapper components — just direct composition.

## RULES
- Use inline `style={{}}` for complex CSS
- Tailwind for standard values
- `"use client"` only on pricing-section.tsx (for billing toggle state)
- NO `any` types
- Image paths from HTML: `/images/webflow/FILENAME`
- Text WORD FOR WORD
- ALL responsive breakpoints
- Match EVERY CSS property

Also read and update if needed:
- `src/lib/constants/faq.ts`
- `src/lib/constants/pricing.ts`

WRITE ALL FILES NOW.
